sources.role: Existing generic const_smul rule preserving the original real normed module
sources.raw_excerpt:
theorem HasFDerivWithinAt.const_smul (h : HasFDerivWithinAt f f' s x) (c : R) :
    HasFDerivWithinAt (c • f) (c • f') s x :=
  HasFDerivAtFilter.const_smul h c

@[to_fun (attr := fun_prop)]
theorem HasFDerivAt.const_smul (h : HasFDerivAt f f' x) (c : R) :
    HasFDerivAt (c • f) (c • f') x :=
  HasFDerivAtFilter.const_smul h c

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] {f : E → ℝ} {x : E}
  {f' : StrongDual ℝ E} {s : Set E}

theorem HasFDerivWithinAt.log (hf : HasFDerivWithinAt f f' s x) (hx : f x ≠ 0) :
    HasFDerivWithinAt (fun x => log (f x)) ((f x)⁻¹ • f') s x :=
  (hasDerivAt_log hx).comp_hasFDerivWithinAt x hf

theorem HasFDerivAt.log (hf : HasFDerivAt f f' x) (hx : f x ≠ 0) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun x => log (f x)) ((f x)⁻¹ • f') x :=
  (hasDerivAt_log hx).comp_hasFDerivAt x hf

def primeVariableLogPoint (N : ℕ) (p : Fin 2 → ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ :=
  fun i => Real.log (p i) / Real.log (N : ℝ)

sources.role: Original exact N,p-dependent diagonal Jacobian unchanged
sources.raw_excerpt:
def primeVariableLogJacobian (N : ℕ) (p : Fin 2 → ℝ) :
    (Fin 2 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin 2 → ℝ) :=
  ContinuousLinearMap.pi (fun i =>
    (Real.log (N : ℝ))⁻¹ • ((p i)⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.proj i))
